games.name: One Brain
games.tagline: A daily brain puzzle, plus an endless Challenge Path that keeps getting harder.
points: The daily puzzle is generated from the date, so every player gets the same one with no server. 8 procedural puzzle types (logic, math, memory, pattern, visual, sequence, spatial, word) across 5 difficulty tiers.

Stages of 10 levels that tighten the rules (fewer attempts, a clock, no hints, boss levels); after stage 10 the game creates its own themed stages. AdMob with a polite frequency cap, Play Billing 8, Arabic RTL and dark mode.
